question: From 10-14 February 2025, in which city did India host the annual Conference of the International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS) for the first time?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Delhi** hosted the annual Conference of the **International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)** for the first time from **10-14 February 2025**.
 
• The **International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)** is a global organization dedicated to the study and promotion of public administration and governance.
 
• **India**'s hosting of this prestigious conference signifies its growing role in global administrative and governance discourses.
 
• **New Delhi**, the capital city of India, is known for its infrastructure and ability to host international conferences, summits, and events.
 
• The conference featured discussions on **key topics related to public administration**, policymaking, and global governance.
 
• **New Delhi** has been a hub for numerous international and diplomatic gatherings due to its strategic location and status as India's political capital.
 
• This event provided an opportunity for Indian policymakers and administrative professionals to interact and collaborate with global experts.
 
• Hosting the IIAS conference aligns with India’s efforts to showcase its advancements in **administrative sciences** and governance practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gandhinagar**__

 __
 
• **Gandhinagar**, the capital city of Gujarat, is known for its planned city layout and administrative importance.
 
• It has hosted significant national events like **Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit**, which promotes investment and economic development.
 
• While Gandhinagar has modern infrastructure, it is not known for hosting international conferences like the IIAS meeting.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad**__
 __
 
• **Hyderabad**, the capital of Telangana, is a major IT hub and known for its rich heritage.
 
• It has hosted events like **Global Entrepreneurship Summit** and **UN Biodiversity Conference**, showcasing its capability for international gatherings.
 
• However, the IIAS conference was not held in Hyderabad in 2025.
 
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**__
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**, another prominent city in Gujarat, is known for its commercial significance and historic landmarks.
 
• It has hosted events like the **World Heritage City Conference** and **Vibrant Gujarat** but was not chosen for the IIAS conference.
